---
title: "Templates"
---

The reusable templates RIPLRT members use throughout a project's life are provided as **downloadable PDFs**. Download the one you need, print it or fill it on screen, and keep your copy in your project space — there's no master to edit here.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}

| Template | Use when | Download |
|---|---|---|
| New Member Onboarding Checklist | Someone joins | [PDF](pdf/new-member-onboarding-checklist.pdf) |
| Project Pod Charter | A project starts | [PDF](pdf/project-pod-charter.pdf) |
| Individual Development Plan (IDP) | Each semester, per member | [PDF](pdf/individual-development-plan.pdf) |
| Student Research Plan | A student scopes a project | [PDF](pdf/student-research-plan.pdf) |
| Manuscript Planning Sheet | Before drafting a paper | [PDF](pdf/manuscript-planning-sheet.pdf) |
| Authorship / Contributorship Agreement | Project start; updated as roles change | [PDF](pdf/authorship-contributorship-agreement.pdf) |
| Data-Use & Access Checklist | Before touching project data | [PDF](pdf/data-use-access-checklist.pdf) |
| GitHub Repository Checklist | New repo setup | [PDF](pdf/github-repo-checklist.pdf) |
| Reproducible Analysis Checklist | Before any submission | [PDF](pdf/reproducible-analysis-checklist.pdf) |
| AI-Use Disclosure Form | Any product with material AI assistance | [PDF](pdf/ai-use-disclosure.pdf) |
| Conference Abstract Planning Sheet | Before an abstract deadline | [PDF](pdf/conference-abstract-planning.pdf) |
| Weekly Meeting Agenda | Every pod meeting | [PDF](pdf/weekly-meeting-agenda.pdf) |
| One-on-One Mentoring Meeting | Biweekly mentor↔mentee | [PDF](pdf/one-on-one-meeting.pdf) |
| Stop / Start / Continue Feedback | Reviews and retrospectives | [PDF](pdf/stop-start-continue.pdf) |
| Offboarding Checklist | Someone leaves | [PDF](pdf/offboarding-checklist.pdf) |
:::

::: {.callout-tip}
## Editing a template
The PDFs are generated from source files kept in the repository (`/templates/*.qmd`). To change a template, edit its source and regenerate the PDF, then commit both — see `CONTRIBUTING.md`. This keeps every member working from the same current version.
:::
